item.title: News
item.description:
• 2026-11-14 · Congratulations to Shuo Wang, Chen Wang, Hao Hui, Yinbin Gao and Xunchen Liu on the publication of Auto-ignition dynamics of a reacting jet in vitiated crossflow studied by burst-mode PIV and PLIF thermometry in Experimental Thermal and Fluid Science, 2026, 179: 111859.
  • 2026-09-01 · Welcome the 2026 M.Sc. students: Xie Jingtong, Wu Wenshuo, Liu Yongji and Adrien
  • 2026-06-12 · Congratulations to three undergraduates, Ding Zitian, Sun Yonghao and Zhao Yongchao, on completing their B.Sc. thesis defence (Ding Zitian: design and construction of an automatic detection system for coal volatile components; Sun Yonghao: pitch and rotation structure design of an angle-adjustable background plate; Zhao Yongchao: design of a background radiation plate with adjustable temperature and emissivity)
  • 2025-09-01 · Welcome the 2025 M.Sc. students: Zhang Hongmin, Zhao Dianhu, Ran Jiaxing, Zhao Xinhao and Zhang Jiayi
  • 2025-06-28 · The low-altitude economy conference was held on 28 June
  • 2025-06-15 · Congratulations to three undergraduates, Zhang Xiaoyu, Cong Feiyu and Li Yang, on completing their B.Sc. thesis defence (Zhang Xiaoyu: design of an intelligent sensing system for mine gas monitoring based on absorption spectroscopy; Cong Feiyu: intelligent coal-quality detection platform based on Raman spectroscopy; Li Yang: optical sensing system for aviation kerosene spray)
  • 2024-09-01 · Welcome the 2024 M.Sc. students: Yinbin Gao, Hao Hui, Shuo Wang, Chen Wang and Ayoub Attou
  • Visit to Prof. Cheng Song’s lab, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
